_meta.source: Outgunned Corebook ENG; original toolkit themes

automatic_weapons.name: Automatic Weapons
automatic_weapons.summary: A failed Reaction without a Basic Success causes Nervous, or 1 extra Grit if already Nervous.

bulletproof_vests.name: Bulletproof Vests
bulletproof_vests.summary: Heroes take −1 when attacking with firearms or ranged weapons.

fighters.name: Fighters
fighters.summary: Heroes take −1 when attacking without a firearm or ranged weapon.

heavy_handed.name: Heavy-handed
heavy_handed.summary: A failed Reaction without a Basic Success causes Tired, or 1 extra Grit if already Tired.

mob.name: Mob
mob.summary: Whenever a Hero loses Grit, they lose 1 additional Grit.

sharp_blades.name: Sharp Blades
sharp_blades.summary: A failed Reaction without a Basic Success causes Hurt, or 1 extra Grit if already Hurt.

tactics.name: Tactics
tactics.summary: Quick Actions used to change range require a coin flip.

walking_hazard.name: Walking Hazard
walking_hazard.summary: Attacking this Enemy is a Dangerous Action Roll.

armored.name: Armored
armored.summary: Heroes take −1 on all rolls made to hit this Enemy.

hard_to_kill.name: Hard to Kill
hard_to_kill.summary: An attack that reaches a Hot Box stops there after granting Adrenaline.

martial_arts.name: Martial Arts
martial_arts.summary: Heroes without Martial Arts take −1 to Action and Reaction Rolls at Melee or Close range.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.summary: The first time the Enemy loses all Grit, it immediately recovers 1.

one_step_ahead.name: One Step Ahead
one_step_ahead.summary: This Enemy has no Weak Spot.

piercing_bullets.name: Piercing Bullets
piercing_bullets.summary: Heroes gain no benefit from bulletproof vests or Partial Cover.

shotguns.name: Shotguns
shotguns.summary: Heroes ending their Action Turn in Melee take −1 to their next Reaction Roll.

explosive_weapons.name: Explosive Weapons
explosive_weapons.summary: Every Hero Reaction Roll is a Gamble.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.summary: Heroes failing to score a Critical Success on Reaction skip their next Action Turn.

rage.name: Rage
rage.summary: The Enemy begins combat with 1 Adrenaline.

titan.name: Titan
titan.summary: A single attack cannot make this Enemy lose more than 1 Grit.

counter.name: Counter
counter.summary: After taking a hit, deal the same Grit loss back to the attacking Hero.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.summary: A Hero must pass Critical Brawn+Dexterity or lose their weapon.

flashbang.name: Flashbang!
flashbang.summary: A Hero must pass Critical Nerves+Awareness or become Distracted and take −1 next roll.

foul_play.name: Foul Play
foul_play.summary: A Hero must pass Critical Crime+Awareness or lose their next Action Turn.

grab_and_throw.name: Grab and Throw
grab_and_throw.summary: After attacking, a Hero must pass Critical Brawn+Endure or become prone.

not_so_fast.name: I Don’t Think So!
not_so_fast.summary: Cancel a Hero’s Adrenaline-powered Feat without consuming their resource.

pile_on.name: Pile On
pile_on.summary: The Hero with the least Grit immediately loses 2 Grit.

tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.summary: A Hero must pass Critical Brawn+Force or take −1 to their next roll.

call_for_backup.name: Call for Backup
call_for_backup.summary: Replace this Enemy with one of a higher Template or Type.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.summary: Heroes can no longer spend Adrenaline to add dice.

clamp_down.name: Clamp Down
clamp_down.summary: Heroes failing Basic Brawn+Stealth become trapped.

grenade.name: Grenade
grenade.summary: All Heroes make an Extreme Brawn+Stunt Reaction; an Impossible Success sends it back.

parry.name: Parry
parry.summary: Ignore all Grit loss from one Hero’s hit.

surround.name: Surround
surround.summary: Heroes must spend 1 Grit to use their free Quick Action.

threats.name: Threats
threats.summary: A Hero failing Critical Nerves+Cool loses 1 Adrenaline or becomes Scared.

weak_spot.name: Weak Spot
weak_spot.summary: One Hero takes −2 to their next Reaction Roll.

final_move.name: Final Move
final_move.summary: A Hero failing Extreme Brawn+Fight becomes Broken.

infamy.name: Infamy
infamy.summary: Negate one Hero’s use of Adrenaline or Spotlight.

secret_weapon.name: Secret Weapon
secret_weapon.summary: Reveal and immediately gain one Enemy Feat.

to_the_end.name: To the End
to_the_end.summary: Recover 2 Grit, then stop gaining Adrenaline for this combat.
